div.head: II Cn 24.1
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hit man þonne befo, ⁊ he þyllice gewitnesse næbbe, ne beo þær nan team, ac agyfe man þam agenfrigan his agen ⁊ þæt æftergild, ⁊ þæt wite þam þe hit áge.
⁊ gif hit man þonne befo, ⁊ he þillice gewittnysse nabbe, ne beo þar nan team, ac agife man þam ágenfrigean his ægen ⁊ þæt æftergyld, ⁊ þa wite þam þe hit age.
Et si tunc super eum interciętur, et tale testimonium non habeat, non liceat ei aduocare, sed reddat repetenti captale suum et secundam solutionem, et forisfacturam cui pertinebit.
⁊ gyf hit mon ðonne gefó ⁊ he ðyllice gewitnysse næbbe, ne beo ðær nan team, ac gyfe man ðam agenfrigean his agen ⁊ þæt æftergyld ⁊ þæt wite ðam ðe hit áge.
And gyf hit man þonne befo, and he þyllice gewitnesse næbbe, ne beo þær nan team, ac agyfe man þam agenfrigan his agen and þæt æftergild, and þæt wite þam þe hit age.

If, however, any property is attached, and he [who is in possession of it] has no such witnesses, no vouching to warranty shall be allowed, but the property shall be given up to its rightful owner and also the supplementary payment, and the fine to the party who is entitled thereto.

Yet if the purchased goods had previously been in someone’s possession and the purchaser had no such witnesses, then there can be no vouching to warranty, but the goods must be returned to their owner along with a penalty payment and a fine to the proper authority.

And if it is then attached, and he has not such witness, there is to be no vouching to warranty, but the owner is to be given back his own and the additional payment, and he who has the right to it is to be given the fine.

Und wenn es nachher im Anefang eingeklagt wird, und er [der verklagte Besitzer] solche Zeugenschaft nicht hat, so sei da kein Gewährzug [ihm erlaubt], sondern er gebe dem Eigenthümer dessen Eigen zurück sammt nochmaliger Werthzahlung, und das Strafgeld dem, der es [das Recht auf das vom Verklagten Verwirkte] besitzt.

And if it is then attached, and he [the accused possessor] does not have such witness, let there be no vouching to warranty [allowed him], but let him give back to the owner his property together with a second payment of its value, and the fine to the one who owns it [the right to what the accused has forfeited].
div.note: The word æftergyld is unique. The Latin translators understood it to mean “as much again”.
